summary: All 28 task-04 Playwright tests passed in Chromium, including three new regressions for successive sessions at a blurred caret, overlapping responses, and deliberate caret relocation. The existing node tests/verify.js and node tests/dictate.js checks passed. node tests/idea.js failed only its documented, pre-existing toolbar-order check; its other checks passed. No task-04 product bug was reproduced. The required git add -A && git commit attempt failed because Git could not create .git/index.lock on the read-only filesystem; the command was not retried, and the new regression file and this report remain uncommitted. API responses were stubbed, so actual Groq language recognition was not verified.
